headline: Afreximbank Commits $118 Million to Support Nigeria's Creative Economy
summary: The African Export-Import Bank has committed $118 million to help unlock and boost Nigeria's creative economy through trade and investment.
why: Development bank financing aims to stimulate growth in specific emerging sectors, potentially creating new commercial opportunities and improving infrastructure in the region.
